name: ga-annual-property-tax
description: Gabon annual property-tax research reference for the Contribution Foncière Unique on built property and bare land, covering individual and legal-person owners, substituted liable persons, exemptions, valuation and collection evidence. Use for CFU, annual land tax, building tax, title-holder, usufruct, property-manager withholding and joint-ownership questions. It distinguishes individual zonal tariffs from the company rental-value method and from rental income, acquisition duties, disposal gains and the separate occupancy tax. This 2026 draft reads the historical CGI and enacted initial and July finance laws without certifying their complete amendment chain, first operative periods, official zoning or filing workflow. Worked cases apply stated statutory predicates only; unresolved valuation and implementation questions remain on hold.
